summary: The booking layout has minor contrast and positioning issues, notably a tooltip obstructing price details and primary actions sitting below the initial viewport fold.

issues.title: Tooltip obscures price breakdown
issues.description: The active tooltip overlaps the line items directly above its trigger icon, hiding rate details.
issues.evidence: Tooltip box covers text between Price breakdown and Total line in the right sidebar.
issues.suggestion: Reposition tooltip to display above or to the side with adequate clearance.

issues.title: Illegible thumbnail caption overlay
issues.description: Text inside the first media card lacks sufficient contrast against the dark gradient.
issues.evidence: 'Bedroom · king bed' text in the left thumbnail is nearly invisible against dark background.
issues.suggestion: Increase contrast or adjust text color token for dark theme legibility.

issues.title: Primary booking CTAs below the fold
issues.description: Main conversion buttons are pushed below standard 800px viewport height.
issues.evidence: Confirm & pay button is cut off in 1280x800 view and requires scrolling.
issues.suggestion: Tighten vertical spacing in the summary card to keep primary actions above fold.
